availability.note: CarExpert 24 Nov 2026 lists the current (outgoing) NX450h+ Luxury as on sale at 84630 plus ORCs; CarsGuide MY2027 price list also carries it. lexus.com.au configurator returned 403, so not checked directly. Facelift not due until H1 2027.

listPrice.note: EV Central: list price 'plus on-road costs', pricing updated 21 Nov 2026 (flagged as estimated); agrees with CarExpert 24 Nov 2026 '$84,630 plus ORCs' (https://www.carexpert.com.au/car-reviews/2027-lexus-nx-review-quick-drive) and CarsGuide MY2027 MSRP list (https://www.carsguide.com.au/lexus/nx/price/2027). Up from held 84,500.

batteryKwh.note: No usable figure published by Lexus/Toyota. 18.1 kWh is gross (ADAC lists it as 'brutto', https://www.adac.de/rund-ums-fahrzeug/autokatalog/marken-modelle/lexus/nx/az2/342016/). 16.0 usable (~88%) matches lexus-rx-phev on the same pack; third-party estimates for the identical RAV4 PHEV pack range 14-16.7 kWh.

rangeKm.note: ADAC catalogue, NX 450h+ from 07/25, WLTP electric range 72 km on 18-inch (235/60R18), matching the AU Luxury per CarsGuide. Lexus Europe band 70-74 km (https://newsroom.lexus.eu/plugged-in-or-unplugged-lexus-hybrid-technology-sets-the-pace/). AU 87 km label figure is NEDC-derived (CarExpert) and rejected by the direction test.

consumptionKwhPer100km.note: batteryKwh / rangeKm x 100 = 16.0/72x100. ADAC's 11.6 kWh/100km is utility-factor weighted and not used.

bootLitresSeatsUp.note: CarExpert: 520 L seats up, same for all NX powertrains; CarsGuide Luxury review also 520 L. European VDA 545 L not used.

bootLitresSeatsDown.note: CarExpert 2025 review: 1141 L seats folded. Other AU outlets print 1411 L; EU roof-high is 1436 L and the same-platform RAV4 PHEV is 1168 L folded to tonneau (Toyota UK spec), so 1141 is taken as to-the-cover and 1411 as to-roof. Held 1410 replaced per boot-to-cover convention.

towKg.note: Australian braked towing 1000 kg (CarsGuide Luxury review and CarExpert F Sport review). Europe rates 1500 kg (ADAC); AU figure used.

warrantyYears.note: five-year, unlimited-kilometre warranty; battery extension conditional on annual health checks is in pros

insuranceAnnual.note: kept from held row; anchored below lexus-rx-phev (2550/2850 at $105k/$124k), near volvo-xc60-phev plus T8 (2250 at $92,990) and mercedes-glc-phev (2500 at $99,900)

depreciationCurve.note: Owner convention: one curve per brand. Mainstream default used for all Lexus rows; no documented evidence of heavy discounting, and Lexus hybrids hold value. Replaces the held per-grade curves.

combinedRangeKm.note: 72 km WLTP electric + 55 L tank (ADAC; CarsGuide 55 L) / 6.4 L/100km x 100 = 931 km

fuelConsumptionL100km.note: ADAC: 'Verbrauch kombiniert (WLTP) PHEV (Batterie leer)' 6.4 L/100km, charge-sustaining, MY from 07/25. AU testers 5.4-5.7 L/100km (CarsGuide, CarExpert).

isFuelEfficientForLct.note: Lexus AU label combined 1.3 L/100km (also CarExpert spec table), at or below 3.5

isGreenForVicDuty.note: SRO green = combined tailpipe CO2 <= 120 g/km; NX450h+ label 29 g/km (CarExpert spec table, https://www.carexpert.com.au/car-reviews/2025-lexus-nx450h-f-sport-review)
